text:
lina-docs: opened PR to tweak the audit-log retention wording + update SDK/CLI snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523

kevin-legal: quick flag: avoid 'permanent' or 'indefinite' on public pages. SOC2 reviewers prefer explicit guardrails like 'customer-configured' + legal hold exception.

omar-eng: thanks — FYI the Python SDK recently changed the create call shape. current examples use `ttl_seconds` top-level which is stale. new shape is `retention_policy` object. small patch below:
```diff
- client.audit.create(tenant='t_1', ttl_seconds=2592000)
+ client.audit.create(tenant='t_1', retention_policy={'mode':'ttl','seconds':2592000})
```

lina-docs: noted. I'll update the python & curl examples. @tess-privacy do we have an approved short sentence for public docs about legal hold language?

tess-privacy: propose: "Audit logs are retained according to customer-configured retention policies; Redwood will not retain logs beyond configured retention unless required to comply with a legal hold or other legal obligation." keeps it concise and SOC2-friendly.

kevin-legal: LGTM but change 'will not' -> 'does not' reads stronger in docs. also add parenthetical '(see legal playbook via support)' instead of linking internal doc.

lina-docs: ok switching to 'does not' and adding support link. also adding CLI snippet per request:
```
# query retention
rctl audit get --tenant t_1 --output json
# sample output
{
  "tenant": "t_1",
  "retention_policy": {"mode":"ttl","seconds":2592000}
}
```

omar-eng: small note: also show pseudonymization flag — customers ask about PII in logs. example: `pseudonymize=true` on create call.

lina-docs: adding that. will push commit after fixing the code block formatting.

deploy-bot: PR #523 checks — unit tests: passed, link-checker: warning (internal link removed), lint: passed

lina-docs: removed internal link and replaced with support page. pushing patch now. will merge after another quick legal review. thanks! :raised_hands:
